platform_notes.macos: capsword action, explicitly equivalent to caps_word.

basis: Actual catalogue platform and equivalent fields; declarations do not certify native activation.

capability: Idle, typed delimiters and supported pointer settings

platform_notes.windows: AHK policy port; idle zero sentinel is numeric zero.
platform_notes.macos: Actual shared Lua policy; disabled idle is nil.
platform_notes.linux: Actual shared Lua policy; disabled idle is nil.

basis: Eight actual declarations with 24 generated OS flags, shared defaults and recommendations; full driver admission remains separately qualified.

platform_notes.windows: Explicit current-driver exclusion: OS keeps gestures; translated reason is declared.

basis: Manifest platforms and platform_reason.caps_word_gestures_stay_with_windows. Not a claim future Windows interfaces cannot implement it.

capability: User-created hotstring delimiters offered as CapsWord stop choices

platform_notes.macos: Custom runtime delimiters excluded and refused.
platform_notes.linux: Custom runtime delimiters excluded and refused.

basis: Built-in-only shared validation and registered custom-delimiter control; this is an explicit scope decision.

capability: Accepted positive idle remains an enabled positive duration after conversion

platform_notes.windows: An accepted positive value below 0.0005 s rounds to zero and disables expiry in the source-only AHK port.
platform_notes.macos: The same value rounds to numeric zero, enabled under the actual Lua policy.
platform_notes.linux: The same value rounds to numeric zero, enabled under the actual Lua policy.

basis: Actual Lua boundary controls plus exact AHK expressions. Ordinary presets and 10 s defaults are unaffected; driver timer admission corroborates separately.

capability: When saved changes affect an active session

platform_notes.windows: Explicit publication for the next activation.
platform_notes.macos: Settings owner promises next-event live apply; actual timer scheduling must be adjudicated in macOS scope.
platform_notes.linux: Session captures policy, while actual menu promises next-event live apply; Linux scope owns its confirmed caller consequence.

basis: Do not classify Linux snapshot behavior as intentional: Manager implementation and menu promise disagree. No universal shared live-apply policy invented.

capability: Meaning and label of the built-in star delimiter after magic-key rename

platform_notes.windows: Explicit fresh built-in literal-star instance, separate from hotstring magic-key rename.
platform_notes.macos: Menu substitutes current magic key; an already-loaded policy still reads captured literal star. Actual public owner corroborates the mismatch.
platform_notes.linux: Menu substitutes current magic key; actual policy remains literal. Linux production metadata updates do not call the shared catalogue mutation.

basis: CW-S002 is a truthful-setting-label mismatch, not a decision to force dynamic meaning. Literal versus dynamic product intent remains unresolved; Windows full translated caption remains unverified.

capability: Repeated invocation while CapsWord is already active

platform_notes.windows: Catalogue invokes ToggleCapsWord, reaching CapsWordActivationToggle which flips CapsWordEnabled.
platform_notes.macos: Catalogue gesture sets the active variable to one and refreshes activation; generated physical Karabiner action has variable_unless one. These are distinct origins, not one universal toggle.
platform_notes.linux: Catalogue action invokes Manager.toggle_caps_word and ends an active session.

basis: Source-derived variant and macOS owner corroboration. The aliases declare equivalent capability names, but no common rule deciding toggle versus idempotent activation was located. Do not turn this difference into a confirmed bug without a product contract.
